fusions.name: Buckler Check
fusions.desc: A hard check that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rebounding Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a guard that deals 8 damage and then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Narrow Miss
fusions.desc: Raises a guard that soaks 24 damage for 6 seconds. You gain 10% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Guard Up
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 25% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
